answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
